subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared agent-facing inbound attachment metadata contract now, or keep Slack attachments represented only through placeholders and legacy Media* fields for this release?
rationale: The missing data is clear in current source, but the durable fix changes the shared channel/plugin context surface and should not be chosen by automation as a Slack-only field.

options.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
options.body: Introduce a cross-channel structured attachment field and map Slack, Discord, and Telegram metadata while preserving existing Media* and placeholder behavior.

options.title: Keep Current Contract
options.body: Document that Slack file IDs are available through placeholders and download-file guidance, leaving structured metadata deferred.

options.title: Prototype Slack Only
options.body: Add a narrow Slack metadata field first, accepting later migration risk if sibling channels need a different shared shape.

recommendation.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
recommendation.body: Introduce a cross-channel structured attachment field and map Slack, Discord, and Telegram metadata while preserving existing Media* and placeholder behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is tied to the current Slack media/context source and was already asked in the issue discussion for the API direction.
